name: The Compact Font Format Specification
statement: The Compact Font Format: header, INDEX structures, Top and Private DICTs, charsets and CharStrings, as the OpenType CFF table references it. Its notice forbids reproduction, so it is cited only; the PDF retrieved on 2026-11-27 has SHA-256 60e0696c4fac326de597722af37bcdbbd688e0337a548709a287405ff3b3996a.
